lines.text: اتش در خیمها و سوختن بعضی از الات حرب و اشوب در ولایت اصفهان و بغداد *
lines.en: fire in the tents and the burning of some of the weapons of war and turmoil in the province of Isfahan and Baghdad *

lines.text: (حلول راس در برج جدی) دلالت کند بر اعتدال هوا و نیکی گیاه و رونق و شادی بزرگان
lines.en: (The entry of the Head into the sign of Capricorn) indicates the moderation of the weather, the goodness of the plants, and the prosperity and joy of the great ones

lines.text: و خاندانهای قدیم و بلندی کار ایشان و نیکی کشت و زرع و نکبت بد اصلان و ناکسان
lines.en: and the ancient families, the elevation of their affairs, the goodness of the crops and agriculture, and the misfortune of the base and the ignoble

lines.text: و عزت اهل دانش و ارتفاع اسعار (حلول راس در برج دلو) دلالت کند بر نیکی حال عوام
lines.en: and the honor of the people of knowledge and the rise in prices. (The entry of the Head into the sign of Aquarius) indicates the goodness of the condition of the common people

lines.text: الناس و رعایا و خوشی معیشت خلایق و بسیاری خصومتها و ترقی اشجار و نیکی حال رؤسا
lines.en: and the subjects, the pleasantness of the livelihood of the creatures, many enmities, the growth of trees, and the goodness of the condition of the chiefs

lines.text: و خداوندان ضیاع و عقار و سلامت ابدان و مرگ علما و قضاة و اهل دین و فقر (حلول
lines.en: and the owners of estates and lands, the health of bodies, the death of scholars, judges, and religious people, and poverty. (The entry

lines.text: راس در برج حوت) دلالت کند بر کثرت امطار نافعه و استیلای اشراف و ترقی هر صنف
lines.en: of the Head into the sign of Pisces) indicates the abundance of beneficial rains, the dominance of the nobles, and the progress of every class

lines.text: در مرتبه خود و جمع شدن اموال در خزاین و بیوقات و مخالفت سپاهیان و سرهنگان و
lines.en: in its rank, the accumulation of wealth in treasuries and times, the opposition of soldiers and commanders, and

lines.text: فتح راهها و جریان کشتیها و فوت و موت صیادان و بسیاری ماهی و مرغان ابی و شادی
lines.en: the opening of roads, the flow of ships, the death and passing of fishermen, the abundance of fish and water birds, and the joy

lines.text: پادشاهان (فصل دهم تحویل ذنب از برجی ببرجی تحویل ذنب در برج حمل) دلالت
lines.en: of kings. (The tenth chapter: The transfer of the Tail from one sign to another. The transfer of the Tail into the sign of Aries) indicates

lines.text: کند بر اضطراب سلاطین و کثرت سیاست و زیان رعیت از پادشاه و غلبه سفله کان و مرگ
lines.en: the agitation of sultans, the abundance of politics, the harm to the subjects from the king, the dominance of the base, and the death

lines.text: شتر و گوسفند و فساد معادن و نقصان زر و سیم و زدن درمهای قلب و خلاف کردن
lines.en: of camels and sheep, the corruption of mines, the decrease of gold and silver, the minting of counterfeit dirhams, and the opposition

lines.text: خلایق و حدوث شدت فقر در میان عوام (حلول ذنب در برج ثور) دلالت کند بر بد
lines.en: of the creatures, and the occurrence of severe poverty among the common people. (The entry of the Tail into the sign of Taurus) indicates the bad

lines.text: حالی مردم و وزیدن باد سموم در وقت یافت میوها و بیماری حرکه مسافران بجانب
lines.en: condition of the people, the blowing of the simoom wind at the time of finding fruits, the illness of the movement of travelers towards

lines.text: کوهستان و قلت زحمت قلوب در خلایق و کمی فوائد مسافران بجانب شمال و ضیق معاش
lines.en: the mountains, the lack of trouble of hearts among the creatures, the decrease of benefits for travelers towards the north, and the narrowness of livelihood

lines.text: مردم و مرگ گاوان و شتران و نقصان نباتات و بیم زلزله و زیان رسانیدن ملخ (حلول
lines.en: of the people, the death of cows and camels, the decrease of plants, the fear of earthquakes, and the harm caused by locusts. (The entry

lines.text: ذنب در برج جوزا) دلالت کند بر بیم و قحط و جوع و فزع و هلاك مردمان و خروج
lines.en: of the Tail into the sign of Gemini) indicates fear, famine, hunger, terror, the perishing of people, and the emergence

lines.text: اجلاف بر سلاطین و حکام و خونریختن و امکان زلزله با وجود شواهد و امدن بادهای
lines.en: of the uncouth against sultans and rulers, bloodshed, the possibility of earthquakes with the presence of evidence, and the coming of winds

lines.text: سخت چنانکه ابنیه و اشجار و قنوات ضرر رساند و بیماری و جور و ستم و قطع دستها *
lines.en: so strong that they harm buildings, trees, and qanats, illness, tyranny, oppression, and the cutting off of hands *

lines.text: (حلول ذنب در برج سرطان) دلالت کند بر قیمت و گرانی مرغ و ماهی و غرق کشتیها و رنج
lines.en: (The entry of the Tail into the sign of Cancer) indicates the price and expensiveness of poultry and fish, the sinking of ships, and the suffering

lines.text: حیوانات ابی و افت و نکبت مردم و مرگ بسیار و خبرهای دروغ و رفع عدل و داد و شیوع
lines.en: of aquatic animals, the calamity and misfortune of the people, many deaths, false news, the removal of justice and equity, and the spread

lines.text: جور و ستم و انکسار خراجها و خلل خزانها و نکبت دبیران و اهل قلم و ضرر مردم از اب و
lines.en: of tyranny and oppression, the breaking of taxes, the disruption of treasuries, the misfortune of secretaries and people of the pen, and the harm to people from water and

lines.text: کثرت فسق و فجور و نقل و تحویل پادشاه از جائی بجائی (حلول ذنب در برج اسد *)
lines.en: the abundance of debauchery and immorality, and the transfer and movement of the king from one place to another. (The entry of the Tail into the sign of Leo *)

summary.headline: The Tail’s Transfer Through the Signs
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for the Head entering Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by the tenth chapter on the Tail entering Aries through Leo, with forecasts concerning weather, crops, rulers, war, famine, disease, earthquakes, commerce, and social disorder in places including Isfahan and Baghdad.
